articleContent.en: Tim is packing his pajamas for a trip abroad.
articleContent.zh: 提姆正在打包他的睡衣準備出國旅行。

articleContent.en: His family is going to sail on a big ship.
articleContent.zh: 他的家人將要搭乘一艘大船航行。

articleContent.en: He takes an ice cream from the freezer.
articleContent.zh: 他從冷凍庫拿了一支冰淇淋。

articleContent.en: He wants to eat it before it begins to melt.
articleContent.zh: 他想在它開始融化前吃掉它。

articleContent.en: In addition to ice cream, he also brings some cookies.
articleContent.zh: 除了冰淇淋之外，他還帶了一些餅乾。

articleContent.en: He is very excited about this wonderful trip.
articleContent.zh: 他對這趟美好的旅行感到非常興奮。

questions.question: Who is packing for the trip?
What is Tim's family going to do?
options: They are going to sail on a big ship.
They are going to buy a new house.
They are going to sell some fruit.
questions.correct: They are going to sail on a big ship.

questions.question: Where does Tim get the ice cream?
When does Tim want to eat the ice cream?
What does Tim bring in addition to ice cream?
Why is Tim feeling excited?
options: Because of his wonderful trip abroad.
Because he is going to a summer camp.
questions.correct: Because of his wonderful trip abroad.

listeningStage3Data.title: The Smart Monkey on Campus (校園裡的聰明猴子)

articleContent.en: There is a very intelligent monkey on the school campus.
articleContent.zh: 學校校園裡有一隻非常聰明的猴子。

articleContent.en: The teachers teach it how to behave well every day.
articleContent.zh: 老師們每天教牠如何表現良好。

articleContent.en: It is always gentle when it plays with the young students.
articleContent.zh: 當牠和年輕學生玩耍時，牠總是很溫和。

articleContent.en: The monkey's actions inspire many children to love animals.
articleContent.zh: 這隻猴子的行為激勵了許多孩子去愛護動物。

articleContent.en: According to the principal, the monkey will stay here forever.
articleContent.zh: 根據校長的說法，這隻猴子將永遠待在這裡。

questions.question: Who plays with the monkey?
What kind of animal is on the campus?
Where does this smart monkey live?
When is the monkey gentle?
options: When it plays with the young students.
When it sleeps in the tree.
questions.correct: When it plays with the young students.

questions.question: What does the monkey inspire the children to do?
Why does the principal say the monkey will stay?
options: Because it behaves well and everyone loves it.
Because it is too sick to move.
Because no one can catch it.
questions.correct: Because it behaves well and everyone loves it.

listeningStage3Data.title: A Fun Family Gathering (有趣的家庭聚會)

articleContent.en: Many relatives come to visit John's house this weekend.
articleContent.zh: 這個週末許多親戚來拜訪約翰的家。

articleContent.en: They go to a beautiful lake near his house.
articleContent.zh: 他們去他家附近一個美麗的湖泊。

articleContent.en: John's uncle drops his shiny ring to the bottom of the lake.
articleContent.zh: 約翰的叔叔把閃亮的戒指掉到湖底了。

articleContent.en: John dives into the water to find the ring.
articleContent.zh: 約翰潛入水中尋找戒指。

articleContent.en: He wants to improve his diving skills this summer.
articleContent.zh: 他想要在這個夏天改善他的潛水技巧。

articleContent.en: Finally, he finds the ring and everyone cheers for him.
articleContent.zh: 最後，他找到了戒指，大家都為他歡呼。

questions.question: Who comes to visit John's house?
What does John's uncle drop?
Where does the ring fall?
options: To the bottom of the lake.
To the bottom of the ocean.
questions.correct: To the bottom of the lake.

questions.question: When does John's family go to the lake?
What skill does John want to improve?
Why does everyone cheer for John?
options: Because he finally finds the ring.
Because he finally finds the missing dog.
Because he buys them ice cream.
questions.correct: Because he finally finds the ring.

articleContent.en: Deep at the bottom of the ocean, a little mermaid dreamed of the human world.
articleContent.zh: 在海洋深處，一隻小美人魚夢想著人類世界。

articleContent.en: She watched big ships sail above her every day.
articleContent.zh: 她每天看著大船在上方航行。

articleContent.en: Her sisters and other relatives told her it was dangerous.
articleContent.zh: 她的姊妹和其他親戚告訴她這很危險。

articleContent.en: However, her love for a prince made her trade her voice for legs.
articleContent.zh: 然而，她對王子的愛讓她用聲音換取了雙腿。

articleContent.en: In the end, her body began to melt into sea foam.
articleContent.zh: 最後，她的身體開始融化成海浪的泡沫。

questions.question: Who warned the little mermaid that the human world was dangerous?
What did the little mermaid watch every day?
Where did the little mermaid live?
options: Deep at the bottom of the ocean.
On a top of the mountain.
questions.correct: Deep at the bottom of the ocean.

questions.question: When did her body become sea foam?
Why did she trade her voice for legs?
options: Because of her love for a prince.
Because she didn't like to sing.
questions.correct: Because of her love for a prince.

questions.question: How did she feel about the human world?

articleContent.en: According to recent news, our earth is getting warmer every year.
articleContent.zh: 根據最近的新聞，我們的地球每年都在變暖。

articleContent.en: The North Pole is like a giant freezer that keeps the earth cool, but the ice is disappearing fast.
articleContent.zh: 北極就像一個巨大的冷凍庫，讓地球保持涼爽，但冰層正在快速消失。

articleContent.en: We need the help of intelligent scientists to find good solutions.
articleContent.zh: 我們需要聰明的科學家來幫忙尋找好方法。

articleContent.en: In addition to saving water, we must also plant more trees.
articleContent.zh: 除了節約用水之外，我們還必須種植更多的樹木。

articleContent.en: We must take action to improve this terrible situation.
articleContent.zh: 我們必須採取行動來改善這個糟糕的情況。

questions.question: Who is trying to find good solutions for the earth?
What is getting warmer every year?
Where is the giant ice that keeps the earth cool?
When is the earth getting warmer?
Why do we need to plant more trees?
What should we do in addition to saving water?

articleContent.en: Gepetto was a gentle old woodcarver who made a wooden puppet named Pinocchio.
articleContent.zh: 傑佩托是一位溫和的老木雕師，他做了一個名叫皮諾丘的木偶。

articleContent.en: He wanted Pinocchio to be a real boy and go to a school campus.
articleContent.zh: 他希望皮諾丘成為一個真正的男孩，並去校園上學。

articleContent.en: However, Pinocchio did not know how to behave well.
articleContent.zh: 然而，皮諾丘不知道如何表現良好。

articleContent.en: He lied and ran away from home in his pajamas.
articleContent.zh: 他說謊並穿著睡衣離家出走。

articleContent.en: A fairy helped him and tried to inspire him to be good.
articleContent.zh: 一位仙女幫助他，並試圖激勵他變乖。

articleContent.en: Finally, he learned his lesson and became a real human boy.
articleContent.zh: 最後，他學到了教訓並成為一個真正的人類男孩。

questions.question: Who made the wooden puppet named Pinocchio?
What did Pinocchio wear when he ran away?
Where did Gepetto want Pinocchio to go?
options: To the bottom of the lake.

questions.question: When did Pinocchio become a real human boy?
Why did Pinocchio get into trouble?
options: Because he lied and did not know how to behave well.
Because he was a very intelligent boy.
questions.correct: Because he lied and did not know how to behave well.

questions.question: How did the fairy help Pinocchio?
options: She tried to inspire him to be good.
She taught him how to sail a boat.
She put him in the freezer.
questions.correct: She tried to inspire him to be good.
